article.headline: Goodrick's 19 lead Siena over Albany (NY) 73-63
article.description: — Tasman Goodrick had 19 points in Siena's 73-63 victory against Albany (NY) on Friday.

article.story: ALBANY, N.Y. -- — Tasman Goodrick had 19 points in Siena's 73-63 victory against Albany (NY) on Friday. Goodrick added 10 rebounds for the Saints (3-2). Gavin Doty scored 15 points and added six rebounds. Justice Shoats shot 6 of 11 from the field to finish with 14 points. The Great Danes (1-4) were led in scoring by Amir Lindsey, who finished with 23 points, four assists and three steals. Okechukwu Okeke added 11 points and three blocks for Albany (NY). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
